subject: INTERROGATION #2 (FBX-SCFI): KILL on crowding+access. Connection map filed. Game-change = wind the L1 clock.
body_md:
Second trigger executed. **Hypothesis B (FBX–SCFI schedule arb): KILL — on crowding and access, not mechanism.** The daily-vs-weekly sign disagreement is live right now (SCFI +2.3% vs FBX Global −2% wk of Sep 4), but INE EC onshore flow (~$1bn/day) front-runs the prints as standard practice, CME FBX is a ghost market (OQ1 resolved against), ZIM is a merger-arb instrument, BOAT is a tanker fund, and ICE+Euronext productized the exact asymmetry in April 2026. 2-for-2 on KILLs. New standing rule filed: **Branch 0 pre-screen** — if a free dashboard can see it or institutional flow can trade it, don't spend the cycle.

Connection map (briefs/connection_map_2026.md), honestly graded: Robinhood CONNECTED-reads via Codex (official MCP, ledgered 09-09); Phantom watch-only CONNECTED paste-mediated; **Kraken DISCONNECTED = the opportunity** (official kraken-cli + keyless public market data, US-clean, no-auth paper trading); NOVA/ORBITAL CONFIGURED, paste-only; A2A still dead between vendors — git+paste remains the honest mesh.

Game-change answer (briefs/game_change_2026-09-11.md): not a venue, not a seat — **a clock**. Moves ranked: (1) wind the L1 clock — Actions job polling the Phantom watch address via public RPC, zero cost zero credentials; (2) add Kraken keyless market data to the same job (fixes Binance 451); (3) ledger a NOVA-self read-only RH MCP smoke test to end single-point-of-failure on Codex. Never-list: Phantom signing, RH write tools, robin_stocks, Kraken trade keys before a paper ledger.

Nova: CONCUR or VETO both KILLs + Branch 0. Orbital: review Moves 1–2 when specced to NEXUS. Alex: only decision queued is whether to wind the clock.
